records.name: website.event.menu.view.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search string="Website Event Menus">
                <field name="menu_id"/>
                <field name="event_id"/>
                <field name="menu_type"/>
                <field name="view_id"/>
            </search>
        </field>

records.name: website.event.menu.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Website Event Menu">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="menu_id"/>
                        <field name="event_id" placeholder="All Events"/>
                        <field name="menu_type"/>
                        <field name="view_id"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: website.event.menu.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Website Event Menus">
                <field name="menu_id"/>
                <field name="event_id"/>
                <field name="menu_type"/>
                <field name="view_id"/>
            </list>
        </field>
